guarantees.claim: When the parameter EnMasking is true, the second share msgfifo_data[1] is tied to zero.

assumptions.claim: The message data placed into the first share msgfifo_data[0] contains no secret key material.
assumptions.cond: EnMasking is true and the design relies on msgfifo_data[1] being zero for non-secret message.
assumptions.risk: If a secret key enters msgfifo_data[0], only one share carries the secret, breaking the two-share masking and leaking side-channel information.

uncertain_points.claim: It must be verified that no data path ever drives secret key material onto msgfifo_data[0] when EnMasking is true.
uncertain_points.risk: Hardware would bypass masking for the secret, enabling side-channel key extraction.
